message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the precise time, you can check your phone, computer, or an online world clock for “New York City” (Eastern Time Zone).

New York City is Eastern Time Zone. Current time depends on DST. We can compute approximate time if we know current UTC. But we don't have real-time. We could respond that we cannot provide real-time. But maybe we can use the weather_forecast_get function to get weather forecast for New York City, which might include time? But the function only returns forecast, not time. There's no function to get current time. So we should respond that we can't provide real-time. Alternatively, we can approximate by saying "I don't have real-time data." The best answer: "I don't have real-time data, but you can check your device or online." So respond accordingly.
